name: wizact-utilities
description: Essential developer utilities: fast file/code search (fd, ripgrep, ast-grep), desktop notifications, plugin version management

optionalDependencies.ast-grep: For ast-grep-search skill: brew install ast-grep, npm install -g @ast-grep/cli, or pip install ast-grep-cli
optionalDependencies.fd: For fd-search skill: brew install fd-find
optionalDependencies.ripgrep: For ripgrep-search skill: brew install ripgrep
optionalDependencies.growlrrr: For notification hooks (recommended): brew tap moltenbits/tap && brew install growlrrr
optionalDependencies.terminal-notifier: For notification hooks (alternative): brew install terminal-notifier
